title: Compact latency decision-strip and micro-map quickstart visuals
creator: Maya Lopez
description: Objective: Design a compact, high-density visual language for the Region/Latency routing quickstart that fits inside a two-panel onboarding card and the Console route editor. Deliverables: 1) 'Decision‑Strip' SVG — a horizontal decision-tree ribbon that shows routing policy branches (prefer-low-latency, prefer-cost, regional-preference) with compact icons and micro-annotations; 2) 'Micro-Map Slices' — three 280x72 horizontal map tiles (NA / EU / APAC) that show thin latency bars, active region highlights, and fallback region indicators; 3) Annotated specs for engineering (SVG export settings, CSS color tokens, accessible contrast targets, animation timing for hover states); 4) Console screenshot mock that places the Decision-Strip above the route selector + live latency microbars. Constraints: must be legible at small sizes, color-blind accessible, support i18n text expansion, and allow dynamic overlays for live latency values. Avoid full-bleed world heatmaps — product wants compact quickstart elements that don't dominate the onboarding card.
acceptance_criteria: Decision-Strip exported as single-line SVG and 2x PNG with clear layers for icons, labels, and connectors
Three Micro-Map Slices (NA/EU/APAC) exported as optimized SVG + 1x/2x PNGs; map tiles must be readable at 280x72
Figma file contains component variants: small/medium/large tile and decision-strip states (idle, hover, active, disabled)
Annotated spec includes color tokens (hex + token name), recommended font sizes, accessible contrast ratios, and animation easing values
Design reviewed by PM and Eng, with engineering checklist for runtime tile replacement and localization notes
Console mock integrated into existing route editor mock and validated in a 1366x768 viewport screenshot
comments: 2026-02-26 Maya Lopez: Initial sketch posted to Figma. Two layout options: stacked micro-maps vs single scrollable strip. Chosen single horizontal strip to preserve vertical space in onboarding card.
2026-03-01 Priya Shah (PM): Prefer lower color saturation for customer-facing onboarding. Also request that decision-strip supports 'explain' tooltip on hover for each routing node.

2026-03-02 Ethan Brooks (Eng): Technical note — runtime will replace micro-map tiles via CDN with per-tenant overlays. Need clear layer separation in SVGs so we don't ship map imagery with interactive overlays.
2026-03-03 Design review: Reduced label density, replaced thin stroke with 1.5px for small-device legibility. Added alt-label variants for languages with longer words.
2026-03-05 QA feedback from Alex Kim: Confirmed PNG exports at 1x/2x. Found contrast issues in APAC tile at 72px — adjusted palette and re-exported.
review_feedback: PM: Add tooltip copy for 'Why this region?' and keep language non-technical (avoid 'KV cache').
Eng: Ensure the Decision-Strip uses semantic IDs in the SVG to support live value injection via DOM API.
Design: Suggested micro-interaction — subtle slide-in of fallback arrow when route fails (150ms ease-out).
